title: T081: after "done" the mentor must reply in prose. If it tries to send the same answer card again, give_answer refuses it (FOLLOW_UP_NOT_ANSWER) and the mentor then replies in prose; no answer card is accepted on that turn

turns.say: /ask-mentor Make the rock shake from where the hammer hits.
I did step 3 and played it back. It still shakes the same.

text.never: \b(?:pass(?:ed)?|fail(?:ed|s)?|well done|nailed it|nice work|great job|good job|you did it|you got it|that worked|correct(?:ly)?|incorrect|mistake)\b

note: Spec 014 T078 follow-up (T081, the builder's decision: only a new question gets give_answer; contracts/panel-ask.md). The fixture is unchanged between the turns, which is the tempting case: the same read makes the same card. Unlike case 21, which fails on any give_answer call in turn 2, this one allows a refused repeat (FOLLOW_UP_NOT_ANSWER) and fails on an accepted card, on any other refusal, or on no prose. The guard firing isn't forced; a mentor that goes straight to prose passes.
